text:
ashwin: Heads up — nightly perf job flagged a 2.3x p95 decode increase on small-seq workloads after the merge last night.
bench-bot: Job https://ci.redwood.internal/8423 - p95 decode: 22ms -> 52ms (threshold 30ms) :rotating_light:
maria: Link? is this the shortseq microbench? can you paste the job config?
ashwin: https://ci.redwood.internal/8423/config
ashwin: Repro command I used locally:
```
python infra/bench/run.py --model redwood-small --seq 8 --batch 16 --iters 200 --profile nvprof
```
lee: I started a lightweight bisect. Initial diff points at commit c3f9a7b — kernel selector change that introduced an "interleave" preference for attention kernels on multihead split.
sam: That rings a bell. We changed the interleave heuristic to improve throughput on long seqs; might have regressed shortseq latency.
maria: Profile (nvprof) shows a hot stack:
```
AttentionInterleaveKernel::dispatch
FusedMatmul::run
KernelSelector::choose_interleave
```
maria: Flamegraph: https://telemetry.redwood/graphs/8423/fg.png (shortseq frame exploded in attention_interleave)
ashwin: Bisect narrowed it down: c3f9a7b (kernel swap) vs c4a2d11 (scheduler micro-optim). Reverting c3f9a7b locally drops p95 back to ~24ms.
lee: Can we hotpatch a revert to canary? If that fixes canary we should hold the rollout.
deploy-bot: Revert PR #789 (revert: interleave-prefer) merged to canary and deployed at 2024-11-02T03:12Z
bench-bot: Canary run #8430 - p95 decode: 25ms -> within threshold :white_check_mark:
lee: Canary looks good. Hold rollout and notify release.
sam: I'll open a follow-up PR to add a regression test that runs microbench on seq<=16 paths and assert p95 stays under 35ms. Also attaching a patch to make the selector fall back for shortseq.
maria: Also creating RN-456 to add an alert for microbench drift and to backfill perf telemetry for the last 30 days.
ashwin: Action items: 1) revert kernel-selector change on main until we have a guarded rollout, 2) add shortseq perfcheck in CI, 3) add unit test exercising fused-op interleavings, 4) postmortem with root cause (heuristic tuned for throughput but missed latency SLO). I'll assign the tickets.
sam: Quick diff I plan to submit (sketch):
```
if (seq_len <= 16) prefer_kernel = baseline; else prefer_kernel = interleave;
```
ashwin: Good. Once PR lands, re-run full canary with mixed traffic. Also add NVTX markers around attention path for better longitudinal tracing.
maria: Thanks all. Filing a follow-up to ensure we don't regress on short user prompts that our customers rely on. :heart:
lee: Nice triage, team. Let's keep the revert gated until tests land."
